SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, GRNO, GRSEQ, PONO, POSEQ FROM ERPDB.KEPGR WHERE IFFLAG = '0'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SNTD' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, PLANT AS PLANT, PONO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, POSEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, STATUS AS STATUS, ITEMNO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, QTY AS GR_QTY, AMT AS GR_AMT, GRDATE AS GR_DATE, GRNO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, GRSEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, IFDATE AS LOAD_DATE, IFTIME AS LOAD_TIME, REMARK AS REMARK FROM ERPDB.KEPGR WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND GRNO = '$G_RS.GRNO$' AND GRSEQ = '$G_RS.GRSEQ$' AND PONO = '$G_RS.PONO$' AND POSEQ = '$G_RS.POSEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0' ORDER BY PLANT, PONO, POSEQ, GRNO, GRSEQ
UPDATE ERPDB.KEPGR SET IFFLAG = '1' WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND GRNO = '$G_RS.GRNO$' AND GRSEQ = '$G_RS.GRSEQ$' AND PONO = '$G_RS.PONO$' AND POSEQ = '$G_RS.POSEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0'
UPDATE ERPDB.KEPGR SET IFFLAG = '0' WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND GRNO = '$G_RS.GRNO$' AND GRSEQ = '$G_RS.GRSEQ$' AND PONO = '$G_RS.PONO$' AND POSEQ = '$G_RS.POSEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0'
